gates.name: Contributor verification
gates.evidence: Relevant experience, public credentials/work samples, scope and conflicts; named verifier.
gates.outcome: Bounded role and least-privilege access; not automatic expert authority.

gates.name: Source review
gates.evidence: Official provenance, scientific relevance, rights, version, reviewer and expiry.
gates.outcome: Approve only a defined discovery purpose; datasets remain separately gated.

gates.name: Dataset-use review
gates.evidence: Dataset/version, permitted purpose/audience, licensing and privacy determination.
gates.outcome: Allow only the approved use, or quarantine/deny.

gates.name: Claim review
gates.evidence: Exact citation support, evidence type, certainty, limitations and independent scientific decision.
gates.outcome: Approve a specific claim version; no promotion of AI output by default.

gates.name: Release review
gates.evidence: All applicable independent reviews, security tests, audience and corrections plan.
gates.outcome: Maintainer records release or refuses publication.

gates.name: Monitoring / correction
gates.evidence: Retraction, expiry, permission withdrawal, incident or failed effectiveness.
gates.outcome: Suspend dependent use, review impact, correct/revoke and retain controlled history.

releaseRules: No contributor may approve their own scientific claim.
Scientific and rights/privacy review are separate decisions; no single-person approval for a real evidence release.
Conflicts must be declared and a conflicted reviewer replaced for the affected decision.
Unassigned roles and missing, expired or revoked approvals block real-data release.
Public sharing requires explicit authority and review; it is never an automatic tier progression.
No patient uploads, medical recommendations, real source approval or email submissions are enabled in this MVP.
